text:
Isha: Heads-up  customer request: a 'forensics playbook' for model rollouts. They need quick answers for billing disputes + root-cause on quality regressions. Need scope options by EOD.
Marco: Can we clarify outputs? My read: (1) dashboard card with cost & error delta by model_variant, (2) link-to-trace for suspect requests, (3) exportable CSV for finance, (4) per-tenant sampling toggle.
Hannah: Yep. Also ask was explicit about being able to compare two model versions side-by-side and see token-level cost delta for sampled requests.
Devon: Engineering note: adding model_variant at request boundary is trivial. Token-level spans in hot loop are risky. Suggest sampling + aggregated counters as compromise.
Samantha: PM acceptance criteria draft: - Card: last-7/30d cost/error delta; - Drill: opens filtered traces with model_variant and hashed_tenant; - For sampled requests: token timeline + token count + latency per token; - CSV export of samples.
ops-bot: perf-job queued: perf-4477, ETA 36h.
Isha: Propose three proposals to present: Lite / Forensic / Full.
Marco: Lite = aggregated card + trace-filter link (no token mapping). Fast.
Hannah: Forensic = hashed tenant + model_variant propagation + sampled per-token timeline for flagged tenants. Medium effort.
Devon: Full = exact per-token attribution across cache/batch/fallbacks. Large and needs kernel benches + SLOs.
Samantha: Risks: Full touches hot path and could add tail latency. Must have canary + rollback toggle. Add privacy gating: default hash tenant id.
Isha: Revenue note: Sales want Forensic for "audit" upsell; will start conversations if we ship sampling-first.
Marco: Quick pseudocode for propagated attrs we discussed:
```
span.set_attr('hashed_tenant', hash(req.tenant))
span.set_attr('model_variant', req.model)
# emit aggregated token counters per-request rather than spans in hot loop
emit_counter('tokens.emitted', n_tokens, { 'req': req.id })
```
Devon: QA notes: need a reproducible billing dispute playbook (given sample UUID -> show trace -> CSV). Add e2e test.
qa-bot: test-queue created: forensic-smoke-1.
Isha: OK let's lock owners: Marco (product doc + pre-read), Devon (runtime impact + perf), Hannah (GTM/customer asks). Meeting scheduled 11am tomorrow. Please add pre-read links. :calendar:
